paragraphs: Rav Pappa son of Rav Ḥanan, the scribe of Rava (Bava Batra 153a).[^1]

notes.text: כב״ב קנג.. is read as Bava Batra 153a under the period convention, with the doubled stop retained in the Hebrew. No named edition is independently checked. Hyman calls Pappa the son of Rav Ḥanan and the scribe of Rava; both Rav titles are explicit.
